Saarvi Sharma

Full-stack developer and ML practitioner, building from the hills of Himachal.

I build things that learn and things people click.

I’m a fourth-year Computer Science Engineering student at Jaypee University of Information Technology, Waknaghat. My work sits between two worlds: Python-driven machine-learning pipelines and the web apps that put them in front of people.

I write systems code in C, ship interfaces with the MERN stack and Next.js, and currently freelance in data annotation, which keeps me honest about what good training data looks like.
